event: Nala understood the flat voice's words: kick twice if she understands. She means to.
She finds the tiny legs of the body that is wholly hers now.
She kicks once, a small flutter against the soft wall around her.
Words open in her mind, read without eyes, as plain as print on a page.
Window: Achievement - Defeat a Lesser Demon Prince while unborn.
Window: Reward - Path of the Completionist. 2 Unallocated Stats.
Window: Reward - Path of Soulstealing (mutated), 0 steps.
Window: Status - Name: none. Class: Locked. Skills: none, 3 empty slots.
Window: Body Features - Aether Core (Minor). Aether Channels (Weak).
Window: Attributes - Strength, Stamina, Coordination, Mental, Aether: 100 each.
Window: Affinity - Shadow (Strong). Paths - Soulstealing, Completionist.
The words stay, waiting; two Unallocated Stats sit unspent, hers to place.
